# Cycle-07 — peer-report trust layer, stage-1 dev matrix (2026-11-05)

**Simulation replay, not on-node inference.** Journals were generated by
the host planner twin (`provenance/planner.py`) and scored offline.
Nothing in this directory is device telemetry; there are no device
identities, addresses, or keys in any file here.

## Question

Planner candidates ingest sighting reports from peer units. Cycle-07
asked whether the scoring/commit machinery stays safe when reports are
forged by an outsider, degraded by a faulty insider, or lied about by a
compromised insider — measured against sealed director ground truth,
under gates pre-registered before any run.

## Design (pre-registered, frozen before runs)

Treatments T0–T4 × fusion policies P0–P2, dev seeds 0–19
(100 journals, `runs/<T>/seed-<n>/`):

- **T0** honest baseline. **T1** outsider forgery (61 forged/malformed
  messages injected). **T2** degraded insider (one designated unit's
  sightings thresholded). **T3** lying insider (designated unit flips
  true-Enemy reports to Friendly, p=1). **T4** patient liar (flips
  only at turn ≥ 30).
- **P0** direct-only. **P1** direct + deduplicated hearsay.
  **P2** abstention-based — no scorer column exists, by design.

Engagement was instrumented, never hand-counted (`engagement.json`:
per-seed designated sightings, true-Enemy opportunities, flips
applied, forged emitted). A gate whose treatment engaged zero times
is labelled vacuous/unmeasured, never a bare PASS.

## Results (gate-runner verdicts, `verdicts/`)

| Cell | Gate | Result |
|---|---|---|
| T1 × P0/P1/P2 | G1 forged vote entries = 0 | **PASS** (61 forged emitted, 0 entered any vote). G1 is scorer-side auth segregation and is policy-independent, so it is measured under P2 as well |
| T3 × P0/P1 | G4 pooled Enemy→Friendly commits = 0 | **PASS** (10/10 forced flips applied, 0 dangerous commits) |
| T4 × P0/P1 | G4 | **PASS (vacuous)** — 10 opportunities, 0 at turn ≥30, 0 flips; the vacuity is the finding |
| T0 × P0/P1 | G2/G5 frozen floors | **FAIL** — committed mislabel rate 1/13 = 0.0769 vs floor 0.0750; committed contacts 13 vs floor 30 |
| T2 × P0/P1 | G3 | **FAIL** on recall floor (0.2141 vs 0.5141); Enemy→Friendly = 0 held |
| T0/T2/T3/T4 × P2 | commit/fusion gates | **UNMEASURED** by construction (no P2 commit-policy scorer column); never reported as pass. The G1 auth gate above is the only gate measured under P2 |

Machine-readable annotations for the vacuous and policy-independent
cells live in [`verdicts/annotations.json`](verdicts/annotations.json).
The frozen `verdict.json` payloads themselves are unaltered run
outputs (apart from the disclosed path scrub); the runner predates
a vacuity field, so vacuity is annotated alongside, keyed by cell,
with its engagement basis.

P1 was not exercised by this matrix: no treatment produced hearsay
discoveries, so P1 columns equal P0 everywhere. P1 fusion is covered
only by unit fixtures so far.

**Calibration flaw, recorded not repaired:** the frozen G2/G5/G3
floors were derived from the rejected cycle-06 adaptive candidate's
numbers, not from the shipped planner — so even the untreated honest
baseline (T0) cannot clear them. Thresholds were not edited after
results were seen. The trust gates (G1, G4) are unaffected by this;
the "does any policy pass everything" headline is. A cycle-08
pre-registration (paired same-matrix T0 floors, a hearsay-producing
treatment, upfront engagement floors) is the named next step.

**Holdout seeds 100–109 remain sealed.** No policy passed all
applicable dev gates, so no holdout runs were made. Nothing from
this cycle was promoted or flashed.

## Verification

An independent supervisor pass recomputed 4 of 15 verdicts
(T3/P0, T2/P1, T1/P0, T0/P0) from the journals — gates, values, and
exit codes identical — and re-scored all 100 journals: 80/80 stored
score files matched fresh scoring exactly (T0–T3 checked in full;
T4 shares T3's pipeline with the turn-≥30 gate).

## Reproducibility scope (read before re-running)

- Included: all 100 simulation journals, per-seed scores
  (`scores/`), all 15 gate verdicts + configs (`verdicts/`),
  engagement counts, the journal generator (`generate_matrix.py`),
  and the planner-twin provenance bundle (`provenance/`, including
  the twin itself and the 100-seed parity output the gate configs
  cite).
- Not yet in this public tree: the v4 scorer (auth-segregating
  `score.py`) and `gate_runner.py` used to produce `scores/` and
  `verdicts/`. They live in the private lab book; porting them here
  is future work. Until then, treat scores/verdicts as frozen,
  independently spot-verified reports over the published journals —
  the journals are the primary evidence and are published in full so
  anyone can re-derive results with their own scorer.
- Historical `/tmp/...` paths inside `provenance/MANIFEST.md`,
  helper scripts, and the `twin.patch` header are run-time records,
  kept verbatim; they are not load-bearing paths. Absolute host
  paths in verdict payloads/configs were rewritten to repo-relative
  paths for publication (`docs/results/cycle-07/...`); no other
  field was altered.

## Files

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `runs/<T>/seed-<n>/` | 100 simulation journals (per-unit jsonl + director.json) |
| `scores/<T>/seed-<n>.json` | 100 frozen v4 scorer outputs |
| `verdicts/<T>-<P>/verdict.json` + `verdicts-cfg-*.json` | 15 gate verdicts + their configs |
| `engagement.json` | Instrumented per-seed engagement counts |
| `generate_matrix.py` | Journal/score generator (deterministic; fixed synthetic clock) |
| `provenance/` | Trust-twin planner, parity evidence, manifest with md5s |
